solo.title: The Altar, The Home & The Field
solo.subtitle: Integrating the Three-Fold Cord for Success
solo.description: Exploring the spiritual intersection of personal devotion (Altar), daily vocational labour and society (Field), and domestic sanctuary (Home), revealing how imbalance in one fractures the whole.
solo.synopsis: A three-fold cord is not quickly broken. This work unites the Altar of personal devotion, the Home of family order, and the Field of vocational labour into a single architecture of success — showing how neglect of any one strand fractures the whole.
focusPoints: The Altar — personal devotion & spiritual formation
The Home — domestic sanctuary & family order
The Field — vocational labour & societal influence
Integrating the three-fold cord for lasting success

solo.title: Deleazo
solo.subtitle: Moving Beyond the Butterflies to the Stability of Love
solo.description: Dismantling emotional infatuation and superficial romantic thrills to anchor relationships in enduring resilience, psychological maturity, and shared covenant reality.
solo.synopsis: Deleazo — to cleave with intent. This book dismantles the shallow high of emotional infatuation and rebuilds love on the stability of covenant, psychological maturity, and shared reality.

solo.title: Unmasking the Strange Partner
solo.subtitle: 10 Signs You Are Dating a Stranger
solo.description: Diagnostic insights on behavioral inconsistencies, hidden character red flags, and discernment frameworks before emotional or marital entanglement.
solo.synopsis: Ten diagnostic signs that expose when charm is hiding a stranger. A discernment framework for reading character before emotional or marital entanglement — because character, not chemistry, is what you actually marry.

solo.title: The Far Bond
solo.subtitle: Keeping Hearts Connected When Worlds Apart
solo.description: Practical, time-tested relational engineering for cross-border, diaspora, or career-separated couples to maintain intimacy, trust, and alignment without erosion.
solo.synopsis: Distance does not dissolve a bond — neglect does. Practical, time-tested relational engineering for cross-border, diaspora, and career-separated couples to hold intimacy, trust, and alignment across the miles without erosion.

solo.title: 360 Degrees Man of Capacity
solo.subtitle: A Modern Man's Blueprint
solo.description: A comprehensive blueprint for modern men to develop spiritual authority, emotional intelligence, financial stewardship, and physical and intellectual discipline.
solo.synopsis: A complete 360-degree blueprint for the modern man — spiritual authority, emotional intelligence, financial stewardship, and physical and intellectual discipline held in one integrated life.

solo.title: Don't Marry
solo.subtitle: The Truth for Those Who Can Receive It
solo.description: A provocative yet sobering precautionary guide examining the hidden costs of premature or ill-prepared marital vows — counting the tower cost before laying brick.
solo.synopsis: A sobering, provocative precaution — the hidden costs of premature or ill-prepared vows. Count the tower before you lay the brick; the altar only consecrates what the table has already prepared. For those who can receive it.
focusPoints: Counting the cost before the vow

solo.title: Sides of Life
solo.subtitle: For Better or Bitter
solo.description: Philosophy and pastoral psychology on response-ability; turning life's inevitable pressure points into refinement rather than cynicism.
solo.synopsis: Every life meets the same pressure; the difference is posture. A pastoral psychology of response-ability — choosing better over bitter, and turning pressure into refinement rather than cynicism.
focusPoints: The psychology of better or bitter

solo.title: Love Scan
solo.subtitle: Questions to Ask Before 'I Do'
solo.description: A structured audit checklist of deep relational, theological, financial, and family-background interrogation probes for engaged partners.
solo.synopsis: A friendly path to knowing yourself, learning your partner, and asking the essential questions. A structured audit of relational, theological, financial, and family-background probes for engaged partners — before the 'I do'.

solo.title: Love Capsules
solo.subtitle: 500 Powerful Nuggets to Build a Relationship That Lasts
solo.description: A dense compendium of 500 sharp, high-density conceptual nuggets designed for daily meditation, counseling preparation, and relational recalibration.
solo.synopsis: Five hundred sharp, high-density nuggets engineered for daily meditation, counseling preparation, and relational recalibration — a dense compendium of wisdom distilled to a sentence, built to make a relationship last.

solo.title: Love Scope
solo.subtitle: A Guide to the Heart, Head & Hand of Modern Relationships
solo.description: Mapping the breadth, boundaries, and emotional architecture required to love wisely, sacrificially, and sustainably.
solo.synopsis: A guide to the Heart, Head, and Hand of modern relationships — mapping the emotional architecture, mental alignment, and practical action required to love wisely, sacrificially, and sustainably.

solo.title: You Need a Jethro
solo.subtitle: The Governance of Counsel · Vol. One
solo.description: Administrative, spiritual, and mentorship governance lessons on why burnout happens when leaders reject external counsel, systems review, and operational delegation.
solo.synopsis: Volume One of the Governance of Counsel. Administrative, spiritual, and mentorship lessons on why burnout is inevitable when leaders reject external counsel, systems review, and operational delegation — and how to build the layers that outlast the leader.

solo.title: Skills & Boundaries
solo.subtitle: Protecting Your Skills, Maximizing Your Value
solo.description: Defining personal, professional, and relational competency limits to prevent scope creep, burnout, and emotional exploitation.
solo.synopsis: Your skills are an asset; your boundaries are its fence. A framework for defining competency limits to protect your skills, prevent scope creep and burnout, and maximize your true value.

solo.title: Word Your World
solo.subtitle: Speak Your Future into Existence
solo.description: Linguistic discipline, declarative alignment, and how internal monologue and verbal architecture shape external reality and destiny.
solo.synopsis: Words build worlds — and they demolish them. A treatise on linguistic discipline, declarative alignment, and how internal monologue and verbal architecture shape external reality and destiny. Speak your future into existence.

solo.title: Vessels & Scepters
solo.subtitle: Unlocking Heaven's Favour Through Earthly Excellence
solo.description: Kingdom leadership dynamics focusing on character preparation (vessel) meeting governmental authority and influence (scepter).
solo.synopsis: Heaven's favour flows through earthly excellence. Kingdom leadership dynamics where character preparation (the vessel) meets governmental authority and influence (the scepter) — and both must be ready.

solo.title: Marital Battles, Kingdom Victories
solo.subtitle: Tactical Resilience for Marriages
solo.description: Spiritual warfare, forgiveness mechanics, and tactical resilience for marriages under systemic external or internal pressure.
